Question
========
For the reference string A B C D A B E A B C D E on a 3-element cache, what is the best maximum hit rate, given a replacement algorithm that can even see the future (without prefetching)?


Answerlist
----------
* 42%
* 50%
* 100%
* 58%

Solution
========
The optimal algorithm evicts the element whose next use is the farthest in the future. On this string it obtains 5 hits out of 12 accesses, i.e. about 42 percent. The first three accesses are compulsory misses that no algorithm can avoid.

Answerlist
----------
* 1. The optimal policy reaches 5 hits out of 12 accesses, i.e. 41.7 percent.
* 0. Too optimistic; the compulsory misses on A, B and C alone forbid it.
* 0. The first accesses to each element are compulsory misses.
* 0. This is the miss rate of the optimal policy, not its hit rate.
